concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-modifications-not-processed]] — 2026-09-15 unprocessed capture/cancel/refund attempt report with distinct original/modification references, amounts and currencies, unchanged original Customer Area status, event reason and time-zone qualification; it gives no retry authorization.
warnings: A listed unprocessed attempt and its failure webhook do not prove the outcome of any later retry; inspect the original operation and failure context before acting.
The page supplies no report access role, retry procedure or specific time zone, and its Creation Date column is described in capture-specific terms despite the broader report population.
